cohort: The study included 86 women with grade II, III or IV uterovaginal prolapse (cases) and 258 women free from uterovaginal prolapse but with other gynecologic diseases (controls) who attended gynecologic outpatient departments in Nekemte town.
finding: Age ≥ 40 years, prolonged labor (≥ 24 h), instrumental delivery, non-utilization of family planning, and underweight (BMI < 18.5 kg/m2) were identified as determinant factors of uterovaginal prolapse.
mod_finding: Instrumental delivery was identified as a determinant factor of uterovaginal prolapse, with an AOR of 7.40.
